_comment: Read-only audit of live published coverage before the local research additions. A source being registered or returning HTTP 200 is not proof of a captured merger.

watcherEvents.note: Reviewed both pages for Formation/Orca/Loopscale merger text; unrelated uses of capital formation excluded.

protocolCoverage.note: Protocol integration coverage existed; it did not record the combined operating team.

conclusion: Merger not captured in reviewed live events or curated research. Only Orca homepage was registered; Loopscale and Formation FAQs were absent. Website read status was ok after announcement but unchanged, which does not establish why the announcement was missed.
activation: Local protocol-organization/source and curated-event additions only; no deployment, scheduled run, database write or notification.
